title: JBMC's defects under --confirm, the unmasked-shift claims and the full-range default: the corpus under JBMC, auto and --confirm, and the integration tests (rerun of 20261106-203452)
description: Rerun of job 20261106-203452 (step 3 of llm-dlc/loops/engine-priorities.md), whose triage is under Progress in llm-dlc/loops/engine-priorities-jbmc.md. That job's --confirm step had 12 disagreements, all on conformance/caught, caughtAsRuntime and nestedHandler under strict and assume: the own checker proves 'n != 0 || result == -1', and JBMC's confirming run refutes it at n=0 through the defects the preflight names (return-past-handler, stubbed-handler: JBMC 6.11.0 lets the division's exception past the handler), on a witness the interpreter does not reproduce. The tool called that a disagreement (unverifiable, with JBMC's witness as the counterexample). Now equivalence::confirm runs the preflight on a refutation too: where it names a defect and the witness does not reproduce in the interpreter, the refutation is the defect's, as a JBMC proof through one is refused, so the confirmation is no-verdict and the own checker's proof stands, unconfirmed, the line naming the defect. A witness that reproduces is still a disagreement. Tested inline with a stand-in JBMC (conformance.rs, confirm_takes_a_refutation_through_a_jbmc_defect_for_no_verdict) and checked by hand on the real JBMC on the three methods. Since -203452 ran, the unmasked-shift defect was guarded (conformance/shiftRight/3, shiftUnsigned/3 added) and JBMC's default staging became full-range (step 2c, from job 20261106-201041): neither has run through the ignored corpus tests yet. The integration step of -203452 failed in the_tools_own_checker_agrees_with_jbmc_on_integer_proofs, on the own checker's (not JBMC's) regression proof of fixtures.Pricing#total (the rounding refactor), out of its 600 s: the own checker's branch probes have a wall-clock budget, so its path order depends on timing, and inline on cvm 2 of 8 identical runs did not finish in 40 s where the others took 4 s. That is lib/src/bmc/, the native stream's, recorded for it; this job may meet it again. Its tee also failed, since lib/target did not exist yet in the fresh checkout: the steps now create it.
expected: Steps 2 and 3 exit 0. Under --confirm, caught/1, caughtAsRuntime/1 and nestedHandler/1 are Verified with confirmation no-verdict naming the defect, and no disagreement is reported. Under --engine jbmc, shiftRight/3 and shiftUnsigned/3 are no verdict (the proof refused, naming unmasked-shift); under auto, violations. Step 1 exits 0, or fails only at the own checker's Pricing#total regression proof being out of time (the native stream's timing-dependent search, recorded under Progress); any other failure is a finding to triage, as is a claim JBMC says Verified that the JVM refutes.
